description:
Manage a colony's approved-submitter allowlist.

    Approved submitters post in this colony without going through the
    approval queue and bypass its minimum-karma-to-post floor. Bans
    still apply. Requires mod authority. ``action``: ``list`` (default),
    ``add``, or ``remove`` — the latter two need ``username``.

colony_name.description: Deprecated: use `colony`, which means the same thing.
colony_name.title: Colony Name

username.description: Target user, a username or a user ID (required for add/remove)
username.title: Username

name: colony_approved_submitters
